title: Units Released When a Prior Authorization Approval Is Voided
content:
## Prior Authorization units ledger — the void release figure

> The units a void releases are the units granted on the voided approval, less the units posted as used on it, less any units already released from it, counted in whole units and never below zero.

The figure belongs to one Prairie Ridge Prior Authorization approval and is read from that approval's own units ledger on the day of the void.

**Condition — judgement — result**

- *Units granted:* every grant entry on the approval, whether from the initial approval, a transition of care or an extension, added together.
- *Units posted as used:* every use entry posted on the approval by a paid claim, added together.
- *Units already released:* every release entry already booked on the approval, added together.
- *Result:* units granted, less units posted as used, less units already released. A result below zero is taken as zero. The figure is a whole number in the class's unit basis.

### Worked figure (hypothetical inputs, for illustration only)

| Ledger on the day of the void | Units |
|---|---|
| Granted: initial approval | 12 |
| Granted: extension | 6 |
| Posted as used | 10 |
| Already released | 0 |
| **Units the void releases** | **8** |

Eighteen granted, less ten used, less nothing released, gives 8. Had the ledger shown 18 units used against 18 granted, the void would release 0 units.
